title: pelargonium selinum
intro: Pelargonium selinum, commonly known as Cape Geranium, is a species of flowering plant within the Geraniaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial actions that can aid in soothing digestive issues, reducing fever, and promoting wound healing. The health benefits of Pelargonium selinum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, which have been shown to exhibit therapeutic actions like antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antibacterial activities. The therapeutic actions of this plant can be attributed to its ability to calm digestive issues, reduce fever, and promote wound healing, making it a valuable remedy in traditional medicine.
